name: Quick Spin
author: Quick Spin contributors (based on Trifecta by emb417)
description: Forked from Trifecta by emb417. Fast cabinet carousel with vertical or horizontal wheel layouts, still previews, most-played sorting, and optional rotated loading images or animated GIFs.
change_log: Added a playfield mounting-rotation correction so horizontal and vertical wheels align on physically rotated cabinet panels.
